name: sysmlpy-lsp
description: SysML v2 language support powered by sysmlpy — diagnostics, outline, hover, go-to-definition, completion.

sysmlpy.serverPath.description: Command used to start the sysmlpy language server (e.g. 'sysmlpy-lsp' on PATH, or an absolute path).

sysmlpy.serverArgs.description: Extra arguments passed to the language server executable (e.g. --log /tmp/lsp.log).

sysmlpy.trace.server.description: Trace communication between VS Code and the sysmlpy language server.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: echo 'no build step — plain JS extension'
